exposure: Indication for cesarean section (elective vs. intrapartum)
Reason for elective CS (prior CS, fetal malpresentation, multiple gestation, cephalopelvic disproportion)
outcome: Fall in hemoglobin (Hb) and hematocrit (Hct) levels after CS
cohort: 1568 women who underwent cesarean section (1153 elective, 415 intrapartum) after 24 weeks' gestation
finding: Carbetocin and oxytocin had differential effects on hemorrhage-related outcomes after cesarean section depending on the indication for the procedure.
mod_finding: Compared to oxytocin, carbetocin was associated with decreased Hb/Hct falls, need for additional uterotonics, and transfusions in specific elective CS subgroups (prior CS, fetal malpresentation, multiple gestation), and decreased need for additional uterotonics and transfusions in intrapartum CS for dysfunctional labor.
